HOME.HERO_SUBTITLE: A modern template for building scalable web applications. Clean architecture, reusable components and best practices in one place.
HOME.VALUE_SUBTITLE: Nx monorepo, Angular, NgRx, Tailwind and documentation to keep the team aligned.
HOME.VALUE_1_DESC: Feature-based libs, clear boundaries and lazy loading so you only load what you need.
HOME.VALUE_2_DESC: NgRx for global state and router store to keep the UI in sync with the URL.
HOME.VALUE_3_DESC: Shared components, Atomic Design and Tailwind for a solid design system.
HOME.HOW_SUBTITLE: From clone to deploy in a few steps.
HOME.HOW_1_DESC: Use the repo as a base, install dependencies and run the app locally.
HOME.HOW_2_DESC: Change branding, routes and features. The structure already follows best practices.
HOME.HOW_3_DESC: Production build and deploy to Firebase Hosting or the infrastructure of your choice.
HOME.CTA_FINAL_SUBTITLE: Open the sample profile or read the documentation in the README.
